Can you show a screen shot? I can't picture what you're describing.

Are you perhaps talking about displaying the message list in Cards Layout rather than Table Layout?

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/getting-started-thunderbird-main-window-supernova

See <Settings | General | Reading & Display | Open Messages In...>. Do those options give you the desired results?

Thunderbird for desktop OSs and Thunderbird Android are completely different programs. They can't be compared.
